Files intentionally NOT vendored (per research/gpu_port_proposal.md §3.2)
------------------------------------------------------------------------

upstream-src-path                            reason-not-vendored
src/main.cpp                                 upstream CLI entry point; we call
                                             the kernel directly, not via its CLI
src/util_io.cpp + src/util_io.h              OBJ/STL/PLY reading + .vox/.binvox
                                             writing; we have mesh::Mesh +
                                             chunk::ChunkBuilder
src/timer.h                                  trivially replaceable with std::chrono
src/todo.txt                                 upstream maintainer notes; irrelevant
src/cpu_voxelizer.cpp + src/cpu_voxelizer.h  CPU fallback; we have Session 24's
                                             698-LOC CPU implementation
src/voxelize_solid.cu                        solid voxelisation deferred beyond
                                             v0.2 #3 scope (surface-only lock)
src/util_cuda.cpp + src/util_cuda.h          CUDA error-check helpers; if any
                                             transitively required by voxelize.cu
                                             (empirically confirmed at Session 39:
                                             voxelize.cuh #include chain requires
                                             util_cuda.h + libs/cuda/helper_math.h
                                             + libs/trimesh2/TriMesh.h), the
                                             required subset will be provided as
                                             an in-tree adapter shim in
                                             src/voxel_gpu.cu at Session 40 per
                                             proposal §3.10 open risk item 6
                                             mitigation, NOT vendored here.
src/libs/ (Trimesh2 submodule)               discarded; we use mesh::Mesh

notes:           Per the vendoring pattern (DECISIONS.md 2026-06-18,
                 third_party/README.md, third_party/tinyobjloader/VERSION.txt +
                 third_party/minecraft-data/VERSION.txt precedents): the git-sha
                 above is the load-bearing record; git-ref is informational.
                 The file-sha256 values let a future reader fetch the upstream
                 commit and byte-diff against the vendored files.

                 Vendored read-only. NO modifications to any of the 5 upstream
                 files. Session 39 confirmed byte-identical across two
                 independent fetches. Customisation lives in Session 40's
                 src/voxel_gpu.cu adapter shim, NOT in the vendored files.

                 Session 39 build-system disposition: voxelize.cu has a
                 transitive header dependency chain (voxelize.cuh -> util_cuda.h,
                 libs/cuda/helper_math.h; util.h -> TriMesh.h) whose 3 leaf
                 headers are all on the "NOT vendored" list above. Empirically
                 verified with nvcc 13.0 at Session 39 fetch:

                     $ nvcc -std=c++17 -arch=sm_89 -c voxelize.cu
                     util.h:5:10: fatal error: TriMesh.h: No such file
                                                or directory

                 This surfaces exactly the open risk documented in
                 research/gpu_port_proposal.md §3.10 item 6 + DECISIONS.md
                 2026-07-04 "GPU port scope" open risks item 6. Mitigation
                 (per proposal §3.10 + Session 39 maintainer decision):
                 cuda_voxelizer_vendor is declared as a CMake INTERFACE library
                 marking the SYSTEM-include vendored directory (matches
                 tinyobjloader precedent), NOT compiled as a STATIC target at
                 Session 39. Session 40's src/voxel_gpu.cu adapter will add
                 voxelize.cu as a source and provide the shim symbols for
                 the missing headers.
